svg.title: HomeBrain Atmosphere Motherboard
svg.text: HOMEBRAIN ATMOSPHERE MOTHERBOARD — V1.2-DRAFT DIRECT-SOLDER ASSEMBLY
One dedicated PCB • factory male headers solder through labeled footprints • no inter-module wire harnesses
J1
J2
J3
J4
XIAO
USB-C
THE ELECTRICAL CONNECTIONS ARE COPPER TRACES
Colored routes are visualization only; the finished assembly contains no loose sensor wiring.
Direct-solder footprints
U1 XIAO: insert both factory 1x7 headers; solder underside, inspect, then trim.
J1 hiBCTR BME680
VCC=3V3 • GND=GND • SCL=SCL • SDA=SDA • SDO=NC_BME_SDO • CS=NC_BME_CS
parallel, component side up; insert factory-installed 1x6 male header through J1, solder from the
motherboard underside, inspect, then trim; sensor/board extends left
J2 Teyleten Robot SCD41
GND=GND • VDD=3V3 • SCL=SCL • SDA=SDA
parallel, component side up; insert factory-installed 1x4 male header through J2, solder from the
motherboard underside, inspect, then trim; metal sensor above header
J3 HiLetgo VEML7700
VIN=3V3 • 3Vo=NC_VEML_3VO • GND=GND • SCL=SCL • SDA=SDA
parallel, component side up; insert factory-installed 1x5 male header through J3, solder from the
motherboard underside, inspect, then trim; light sensor above header
J4 PMS5003 supplied red breakout
VCC(+5V)=VBUS • GND=GND • SET=NC_PMS_SET • RXD=TX • TXD=RX
RESET=NC_PMS_RESET • NC1=NC_PMS_1 • NC2=NC_PMS_2
parallel, component side up; insert its factory-installed 1x8 male header through J4; solder from the
motherboard underside, inspect, then trim excess pin length; keyed cable socket faces right
Four 3.4 mm grounded mounting holes accept common #4 screws into printed plastic posts.
